event_brief: Zenith Motors agreed to acquire Orion Steel valued at $2.1 billion on 14 March 2026.
title: Zenith Motors to acquire Orion Steel for $2.1 billion

event_brief: Apex Pharma and Helios Energy have entered into a definitive merger agreement valued at $7.8 billion to combine operations. Helios Energy PLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meridian Insurance Co, will become part of the combined entity. The transaction was approved by leadership on 2 April 2026.
title: Apex Pharma and Helios Energy to merge

event_brief: Quantum Retail agreed to sell its Lotus Foods unit to Evergreen Agro Ltd valued at Rs 3,500 crore on June 2026. Quantum Retail Group will sell its Lotus Foods unit to Evergreen Agro Ltd for Rs 3,500 crore, as it exits non-core businesses. Transaction expected to close in June 2026.
companies: Quantum Retail; Lotus Foods; Evergreen Agro Ltd
title: Quantum Retail to sell its Lotus Foods unit for Rs 3,500 crore

event_brief: Bluewave Telecom launched an unsolicited hostile takeover bid for Crescent Textiles valued at $450 million. The board of Crescent Textiles has mounted defensive measures (including a poison pill) to fend off the takeover approach.
title: Bluewave Telecom launches hostile takeover bid for Crescent Textiles

event_brief: Falcon Airlines announced executive leadership transitions: Priya Nair has been appointed as CEO; Rahul Mehta stepped down from the role of CEO (on 5 June 2026).
people: Priya Nair (appointed CEO); Rahul Mehta (departed CEO)
title: Falcon Airlines appoints Priya Nair as new CEO

event_brief: Nimbus Cloud filed regulatory draft papers for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) to raise $1.2 billion. The public listing will allow public market investors to participate in the company's equity.
title: Nimbus Cloud files draft papers for IPO to raise $1.2 billion

event_brief: Atlas Logistics agreed to acquire Harbor Shipping valued at $95 million on 11 July 2026.
title: Atlas Logistics completes acquisition of Harbor Shipping

event_brief: Sunrise Hospitals announced executive leadership transitions: Meera Iyer has been appointed as Chairperson; Arjun Kapoor stepped down from the role of Managing Director (on 2026).
people: Meera Iyer (appointed Chairperson); Arjun Kapoor (departed Managing Director)
title: Sunrise Hospitals names Meera Iyer Chairperson
